The name Kriday carries the meaning “Play, Joy, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kriday usually hope their child will grow to embody play, joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
